name: Transcript highlight
oneLiner: a glass transcript with timestamps scrolls fast and settles on one line, a marker sweeps the key sentence, then the line lifts out of the page as its own clip card with a time range and a play bar while the transcript steps back
say: when the speaker talks about pulling the best moment out of a long recording ('it reads the whole transcript and finds the one line', 'that sentence became the clip'): the scroll runs while they explain, the line clips out as they say it
